title: Transparent Data Marketplace

marketGap: There is no unified, real‑time platform that aggregates mobile data tariffs from all African operators, lets users compare them transparently, and negotiates bulk discounts for consumers and SMEs.
executionPlan: Build an MVP web/app that crowdsources price data via user submissions and operator APIs, displays side‑by‑side comparisons, and offers a subscription for premium alerts. trend: Off‑grid solar adoption is accelerating across Africa as component costs fall and governments push for energy diversification.
